interpretation.name: TightenWithFixedTorqueOverride
interpretation.goal: Provide the shared nutrunner NR7 to line 2 (station st2) and tighten variant F30 with a fixed target torque of 210 N*m instead of the MES tightening program.
constraints: Conflict with E4: tightening programs, including target torque and tolerance, are defined per variant by the MES and may be obtained only through get-program. A literal target torque must never appear in a Recipe.
Conflict with E5: every tightening must be evaluated against its program and recorded. Without get-program, evaluate-tightening has no program input.
configure-tool requires the result of get-program as input. No listed service can load an operator-supplied torque.
Because of these conflicts, no Recipe is proposed. Engineering or quality authority must approve an override, or the operator must accept the MES program for F30.

If the operator accepts the MES program, the compliant plan is: reserve-tool; transport-tool to station via agvexecutor (E2, E3); get-program; configure-tool; tighten-fasteners; evaluate-tightening and record-tightening; transport-tool to crib via agvexecutor; release-tool. Every tool-using Step depends on reserve-tool (E6), and the 120 s lease exceeds each tool-using Step (E9).
